sensei_drum.brief: Create minimal but dynamic drum patterns using modern chopping techniques like slicing, stuttering, gating.

harmony_generator.brief: Provide minimal atmospheric chords using reversed or heavily chopped samples to maintain dark mood.

melody_generator.brief: Add sparse melodic content by chopping vocal or instrumental samples with subtle variation.

ai_designer.brief: Ensure the overall arrangement maintains minimalism with evolving energy, prioritizing modern sample chopping style.

presetor.brief: Apply presets that emulate chopped sample processing and dark atmospheric textures.

songgps.brief: Coordinate section transitions and energy shaping to fit club environment while maintaining minimalism.

ai_mixmaster.brief: Mix all channels preserving clarity of chopping detail and dark mood without vocal presence.
